moments.title: Community Shield heads to Cardiff
moments.blurb: The 2026 FA Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup winners Manchester City, will be played at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Sunday, August 16, 2026.

angles.name: Cardiff hosts football opener
angles.copy: Cardiff is gearing up for a huge sporting weekend! The Principality Stadium hosts the FA Community Shield next Sunday as Arsenal take on Man City. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Arsenal vs Man City build-up
angles.copy: The traditional curtain-raiser for the new football season is just a week away! Arsenal vs Man City in the Community Shield in Cardiff. Get ready for some silverware!

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially kicks off on Friday, August 21, 2026, with Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Football's back!
angles.copy: Less than two weeks to go! The Premier League returns on August 21st! Who are you predicting for the title this season?

angles.name: Arsenal start title defence
angles.copy: Arsenal begin their title defence at home to Coventry City on August 21st. Can they start strong or will the new boys cause an upset?

moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day at Lord's
moments.blurb: The Hundred 2026 season culminates with Finals Day for both men's and women's competitions at Lord's Cricket Ground in London on Sunday, August 16, 2026.

angles.name: Cricket's big finale
angles.copy: It all comes down to this! The Hundred Finals Day is next Sunday at Lord's. Who will lift the trophy this year?

angles.name: Lord's hosts finals
angles.copy: The Home of Cricket, Lord's, is ready for The Hundred Finals Day next weekend! Catch all the action as the best teams battle it out.

moments.title: The Hundred cricket matches continue
moments.blurb: The action in The Hundred cricket tournament continues this week with several matches scheduled, including Sunrisers Leeds vs Welsh Fire and London Spirit vs Birmingham Phoenix today.

angles.name: Live Hundred action
angles.copy: More Hundred cricket today! Tune in to catch Sunrisers Leeds take on Welsh Fire, plus London Spirit vs Birmingham Phoenix. Who are you supporting?

angles.name: Welsh Fire in action
angles.copy: Our very own Welsh Fire are playing today in The Hundred! Get behind the team as they face Sunrisers Leeds. Come on, Fire!

moments.title: Eastern Electrics Festival today
moments.blurb: The Eastern Electrics Festival is taking place today, August 9, 2026, in London, bringing a day of house, techno, and disco to the capital.

angles.name: London's dance party
angles.copy: Eastern Electrics is ON in London today! Who's raving it up to the best house, techno, and disco? Let us know your favourite set!

angles.name: Festival vibes in the capital
angles.copy: Sun's out, tunes are booming! Eastern Electrics is bringing the biggest dance party to London today. Are you there?

moments.title: Boomtown Festival kicks off this week
moments.blurb: The immersive Boomtown Festival returns to Hampshire from August 12-16, 2026, promising a unique blend of music, art, and theatrical storytelling.

angles.name: Boomtown is calling!
angles.copy: Get ready for the wild ride! Boomtown Festival kicks off in Hampshire this Wednesday. Who's heading to the incredible world of Chapter 13?

angles.name: South West festival vibes
angles.copy: Boomtown is just a few days away in Hampshire! If you're heading to the immersive festival from Devon, tell us what you're most excited for!

moments.title: The Magpies Festival in Yorkshire
moments.blurb: The Magpies Festival, a family-friendly music event, takes place in Yorkshire from August 14-15, 2026, featuring folk, Americana, and roots music.

angles.name: Yorkshire's folk fest
angles.copy: The Magpies Festival is heading to Yorkshire this weekend! Perfect for a relaxed vibe and some incredible folk and roots music. Who's got their tickets?

angles.name: Weekend of roots music
angles.copy: Looking for some great live music this weekend? The Magpies Festival promises two days of amazing folk and Americana. Get those good vibes going!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's collaboration 'Rein Me In' holds the Official UK Singles Chart number one spot for an incredible 20th week, extending its chart record.

angles.name: Chart record breakers
angles.copy: Still at #1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' makes it 20 weeks at the top of the Official UK Singles Chart. What a track!

angles.name: Fender's chart dominance
angles.copy: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean continue their incredible run! 'Rein Me In' is still the UK Number 1. Is it one of the greatest collaborations ever?

moments.title: Happy 67th to Hip Hop pioneer Kurtis Blow
moments.blurb: Groundbreaking American rapper and producer Kurtis Blow, known for hits like 'The Breaks', celebrates his 67th birthday today, August 9, 2026.

angles.name: Hip Hop legend's birthday
angles.copy: Big shout out to Hip Hop pioneer Kurtis Blow, turning 67 today! Still spinning 'The Breaks' on repeat. What's your favourite Kurtis Blow track?

angles.name: 80s Rap icon
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to the legendary Kurtis Blow! The first rapper signed to a major label, he paved the way for so many. An 80s icon!

moments.title: Happy 77th to Dire Straits' Mark Knopfler
moments.blurb: Legendary guitarist and Dire Straits frontman Mark Knopfler, famed for his unique fingerstyle playing, celebrates his 77th birthday on Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

angles.name: Guitar hero's big day
angles.copy: A very Happy 77th Birthday to the incredible Mark Knopfler this Wednesday! Dire Straits wouldn't be the same without his iconic guitar. What's your favourite riff?

angles.name: Celebrating a music legend
angles.copy: Wishing a fantastic 77th Birthday to the one and only Mark Knopfler on August 12th! From 'Sultans of Swing' to his solo work, a true musical genius.

moments.title: Happy 37th to Jonas Brother Joe Jonas
moments.blurb: Singer-songwriter and actor Joe Jonas, best known as a member of the Jonas Brothers and DNCE, celebrates his 37th birthday on Thursday, August 15, 2026.

angles.name: Jonas Brother's birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! Joe Jonas turns 37 this Thursday, August 15th! What's your go-to Jonas Brothers or DNCE track?

angles.name: Pop icon's special day
angles.copy: Throwback to the 00s! Wishing a very Happy 37th Birthday to Joe Jonas on Thursday! Still love their early hits!

moments.title: Happy 68th to the Queen of Pop, Madonna
moments.blurb: The iconic 'Queen of Pop', Madonna, whose career spans decades of groundbreaking music and cultural influence, celebrates her 68th birthday on Friday, August 16, 2026.

angles.name: Queen of Pop's birthday
angles.copy: All hail the Queen! Madonna turns 68 this Friday, August 16th! What's your all-time favourite track from the Material Girl?

angles.name: Celebrating a true icon
angles.copy: From 'Like A Prayer' to 'Hung Up', Madonna has truly defined pop music for generations. Happy 68th Birthday to a living legend next Friday!

moments.title: Happy 81st to Deep Purple's Ian Gillan
moments.blurb: Legendary rock vocalist Ian Gillan, best known as the frontman for Deep Purple, celebrates his 81st birthday on Monday, August 19, 2026.

angles.name: Rock legend's milestone
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 81st Birthday to the incredible Ian Gillan, voice of Deep Purple, this Monday! What's your favourite Deep Purple classic?

angles.name: Deep Purple frontman
angles.copy: Smoke on the Water and a huge Happy 81st Birthday to Ian Gillan on August 19th! Celebrating one of rock's most iconic voices.

moments.title: UK Summer Holidays in full swing
moments.blurb: The summer school holidays are well underway across the UK, with families enjoying breaks and staycations throughout August.

angles.name: Summer holiday fun
angles.copy: Summer holidays are in full swing! Whether you're at the beach, on a staycation, or just enjoying the sunshine, what are your plans for the week ahead?

angles.name: Making the most of summer
angles.copy: August is here and the school holidays are well underway! Share your best summer snaps and tell us how you're making the most of it!
